contract: POST /api/podcasts/:id/match-episodes is admin-only and, for every episode of the podcast without an enclosureURL, matches the episode title against the feed with fuse.js (threshold 0.1) and stores the feed title, subtitle, description, enclosure url/size/type, episode, episode type (default full), season, pubDate and publishedAt, filling only empty fields unless ?override=1, and does not store the feed guid; it answers {numEpisodesUpdated} and emits item_updated only when at least one episode changed. A failed feed fetch answers 0 without touching rows. 401 unauthenticated, 403 non-admin (middleware or admin role check), 404 unknown item, 500 book item.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the five match scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: The feed guid is not persisted by the quick match (Scanner.updateEpisodeWithMatch has no extraData field); the scenario pins the stored episode values instead.

invariants.contract: POST /api/podcasts/:id/match-episodes answers 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin (from the item middleware when the user may not update, and from the controller role check for a non-admin who may update), 403 for an admin who cannot access the item library, 404 for an unknown item and 500 for a book item; no rejected request changes an episode row.

A match stores the matched feed enclosure url, type and size, the episode number, season, type (full when the feed omits it), pubDate, publishedAt, subtitle and description only into empty fields, answers the number of changed episodes and emits item_updated; episodes that already have an enclosure are not considered, so a second call answers 0, changes nothing and emits no event.

With ?override=1 the match overwrites details an unmatched episode already has, so a stored subtitle and description are replaced by the feed values and a cleared enclosure is restored, and the answer counts that episode as updated.
When the feed cannot be fetched the match answers 0 for the unmatched episodes, leaves every episode row unchanged and emits no item_updated.
